title: Assess and operate packaging producer responsibilities
summary: A reviewed producer-responsibility determination with required registration, reporting and payment evidence or a documented reassessment plan.
outcomes: A reviewed producer-responsibility determination with required registration, reporting and payment evidence or a documented reassessment plan.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before placing packaging or packaged goods on a market, and when volumes, packaging activities or entity structure change.

parts.title: Map packaging activities and market data
parts.guidance: Collect the selling entities, destination markets, packaging materials and weights, brand ownership, imports, supply activities and relevant financial periods. Separate estimated quantities from measured records and identify supplier-data gaps.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Determine producer status and local obligations
parts.guidance: The environmental-compliance owner reviews the actual market, producer role, group structure and current eligibility rules. Determine applicable registration, data, reporting, recycling and fee duties; do not apply one country assessment to every sales destination.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.scope: Determine producer status and local obligations

parts.title: Prepare the packaging data and reporting controls
parts.guidance: Build the material and activity schedules under the reviewed classification instructions. Reconcile supplier records, packaging specifications and sales data; document allocation methods, uncertain measurements and the owners of recurring data collection.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Approve the registration and compliance route
parts.guidance: The accountable compliance owner approves the applicability determination, any scheme appointment, required registration and reporting calendar. Obtain specialist review of disputed status or categories before authorizing an external declaration or payment.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.scope: Approve the registration and compliance route

parts.title: Complete approved registrations and reports
parts.guidance: An authorized operator submits the reviewed registrations and packaging reports and arranges approved fees or scheme work through the applicable route. Retain acceptance, rejection and payment evidence; submission or scheme membership alone does not prove every obligation is complete.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Reconcile receipts and reassess changes
parts.guidance: Match reported amounts and payments to the approved data, preserve the calculation trail and assign corrections. Calendar reporting and source reviews and reopen the determination when packaging, volumes, markets or group facts change.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

verify.how: A reviewed producer-responsibility determination with required registration, reporting and payment evidence or a documented reassessment plan.

notes.text: Editorial status: operational draft. Source checked on 2026-11-01. No case-specific legal review, independent professional assurance or completed execution is claimed. Sources establish regional entry points; determine the actual applicable local route with qualified reviewers.

metadata.supportReason: An agent can prepare and reconcile the documented inputs. Named people retain decisions, specialist judgments, physical work and authorized external actions.
